title: Final Answer Inside
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electric field inside the sphere (E1).

title: Final Answer Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electric field outside the sphere (E2).

title: Use of Dielectric Constant
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the dielectric constant in the equations for both regions.

title: Vector Notation
description: Important Criteria: The student must use proper vector notation throughout the solution.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the boundary conditions at the surface of the sphere.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for E1 and E2.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
